설탕 2/3컵 달걀 2개
버터 1/4컵
약간의 오렌지 껍질
한 컵의 밀가루
1/8 티스푼의 소금

1. Melt the butter and let it cool.
2. Put the eggs, sugar, and salt in a bowl and beat.
3. Add the flour to the bowl and mix.
4. Add the butter and orange peel to the mixture and mix.
5. Pour the mixture into the madeleine pan.
6. Bake in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

윗글의 내용과 일치하는 문장을 있는 대로 찾아 고르시오.

ⓐ It takes 10 to 15 minutes to make the mixture.
ⓑ Six kinds of ingredients are needed to make orange madeleines.
ⓒ Before putting the eggs, sugar and salt, you need to put the flour in a bowl.
ⓓ After making the mixture with eggs, sugar, salt and flour, you need to add melted butter and orange peel.
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 틀림 - 10-15분은 굽는 시간이지 혼합물을 만드는 시간이 아님. ⓒ는 틀림 - 밀가루를 먼저 넣지 않고 달걀, 설탕, 소금을 먼저 넣음. ⓑ는 맞음 - 설탕, 달걀, 버터, 오렌지 껍질, 밀가루, 소금으로 6가지. ⓓ는 맞음 - Step 4에서 계란, 설탕, 소금, 밀가루로 혼합물을 만든 후 버터와 오렌지 껍질을 추가함.

The crisp sound of ㉮ (eat) chips made me feel ⓓ better. Now, every time I'm stressed out, I eat cassava chips. Then I feel ⓔ bad again!

ⓐComfort food is food what gives you happiness and comfort when you are sad or angry. When you eat comfort food, you can think of the happy moments from the past. ⓑIt satisfies the heart as well as the stomach. Hi, my name is Chen and I live in Sichuan, China. (A) People in Sichuan love hot and spicy food. (B)I also like spicy food, and my comfort food is malatang. Malatang is named after its key ingredient ⓐmala sauce, which is flavored with a combination of Sichuan pepper and dried chilli pepper. Malatang is usually eaten with vegetables and meat sticks. When my friends and I have a bad day at school and are stressed out, we often go to our favorite shop near school to eat malatang. (C) On several social media platforms, it is clear that malatang is still gaining a lot of attention and love from various regions in China. We had an exam one day and we didn't do well on ⓑ it. On this day, we went there and ate ⓒ malatang. (D) As you know, the dish is well-known for its unique spiciness that makes the tongue be unable to feel anything. I put extra hot sauce in the malatang so that ⓓ it would taste hotter than usual. The spicy soup almost made us cry, but we enjoyed ⓔ it. (E) It made all our stress go away on that day.

ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 같은 대상을 지칭하는 것을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ malatang, ⓓ it(malatang을 가리킴), ⓔ it(malatang을 가리킴)이 모두 같은 대상인 malatang을 지칭합니다.

대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 단어의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

A: I feel so ⓐsleepy today
B: It's because it's ⓑrainy. When it rains, I feel more tired.
A: That's right. Let's eat tteokbokki after school.
B: But it's ⓒsalty. It's not good for your ⓓhealthy.
A: Then, how about salad? I know a good restaurant. They sell ⓔtasty salad.
B: OK. Let's go there.
questions.explanation: 명사에 -y를 붙여 형용사를 만든 형태이다. ⓐ sleepy(졸린) ⓑ rainy(비오는) ⓒ salty(짠) ⓓ healthy(건강한) / 당신의 건강(health) 명사가 적절하다. ⓔ tasty(맛있는)

questions.question:
Boy와 Girl 간의 대화가 자연스럽게 이어지도록 <보기>의 ⓐ~ⓕ를 순서대로 배열한 것은?

<보기>

questions.question:

A: G: Look. It's raining cats and dogs.

G: _________________(b)_________________.

B: G: This juice is on me, Suho.
B: Excuse me? Can you say that again?
G: I said, "This juice is on me." It means "________(c)________."
B: Oh. Thanks a lot.
G: You're welcome.

C: B: Everything looks delicious.
G: Yes. Would you like some of my spaghetti?
B: No, thanks. ____________(d)____________.
G: Not your cup of tea? What does that mean?
B: It means "_____________ⓔ_____________."
G: Oh, I see. You don't like spaghetti.
questions.explanation: 그게 무슨 뜻이야? - (a) 그것은 누군가가 좋아하는 것이 아니다 - (e) 비가 많이 온다는 뜻이야 - (b) 스파게티는 내 취향이 아니다 - (d) 누군가가 나에게 주스를 쏟았다 (e)는 문맥상 적절하지 않다.
